caption: The drawing depicts a single, carved wooden bird mounted on a square base. The bird is rendered in shades of dark reddish brown with areas of muted purple and black, and features rows of yellow and white dots along its wings, body, and tail. The beak is yellow, while the head is dark in color, possibly black or very dark blue, with a single, round eye that is highlighted. The bird is stylized and symmetrical, its body elongated, and is balanced on two straight legs that attach directly to the center of the base. The base is a simple, solid, four-sided block colored similarly to the reddish hues of the bird's body. The composition centers the bird in the middle of the page, with a plain beige background and a thin, rectangular border framing the image.
title: Pa. German Robin Figurine
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
